tasks.title: Delivery-risk investigation
tasks.prompt: You are evaluating fulfillment risk in the Olist marketplace. Identify a state with sufficient order volume and delivery problems worth investigating. Examine whether delivery duration, product categories, or seller composition may help explain the pattern, and support your final conclusions with charts.

tasks.title: Freight-burden investigation
tasks.prompt: You are evaluating freight burden in the Olist marketplace. Identify a product category with an unusual freight burden. Examine whether product weight or volume, order value, seller composition, or geography may help explain the pattern, and support your final conclusions with charts.
